title.narrative: Operation of the Sabil Al Salam Association Ambulance Center in Lebanon (Phase Four)

description.narrative: Enhancing the readiness of ambulance services and the ambulance transport system by transporting patients and the injured to and from hospitals, contributing to saving lives, providing rapid intervention, and reducing mortality in all areas benefiting from the project. Supporting the resilience of the host country in providing ambulance services and the ambulance transport system, strengthening the field ambulance and medical referral system, contributing to alleviating suffering in the health sector, and disbursing staff bonuses and operational costs for three years, ultimately aiming to provide ambulance and ambulance transport services, strengthen the field ambulance and medical referral system, contribute to alleviating suffering in the health sector, enhance the capabilities and resilience of ambulance staff, develop their skills, and strengthen their economic standing and that of the host country.

Supporting the ambulance system in North Lebanon, strengthening the field ambulance and medical referral system for Syrian refugees and the host community, and providing ambulance services in North Lebanon.

The Subul Al-Salam Ambulance Center in North Lebanon is ready to provide ambulance and ambulance transport services and strengthen the field ambulance and medical referral system through (12) ambulances, providing services to (12,500) Syrian refugees and the host community. In addition to providing emergency services on the roads as needed, and empowering specialized manpower.
